rendered: The sodiation of the carbon layer provides only a small capacity: 0.05 mAh/cm^2[1] (120 mAh/g[2]). The authors state this is negligible compared with the plating capacities, which reach up to 12 mAh/cm^2[3]. The plating capacities shown in the figure below run from 0.5[4] to 8 mAh/cm^2[5] in the rate panel (panel c), and reach 12 mAh/cm^2 loading[6] in the repeated-cycling panel (panel d). So the sodiation capacity is far below the plated capacities. Fig. 2[7]
